title: New Year oil anointing ritual begins
byline: The Anointing of Oil ceremony is an important ritual of the Sinhala New Year, symbolizing health, protection, and renewal. On Wednesday, April 15, at 6:54 AM, participants follow age-old customs by applying specially prepared herbal oils.

title: SLPP to move forward learning from past mistakes: Namal
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) National Organizer Namal Rajapaksa says the party will move forward while learning from past mistakes, highlighting the need for reflection, cultural preservation, and youth empowerment.

title: Three-wheeler driver killed in Buttala road accident
byline: A fatal road accident occurred this morning (15) in the Buttala–Unawatuna area along the Wellawaya–Moneragala main road when a three-wheeler collided with a van.

title: Sun directly overhead in Northern areas today
byline: The sun is expected to be directly overhead in several areas in the Northern Province, including Pandatharippu, Thellippalai, Varuthaleivilan, Vasavilan and Manatkaadu, at approximately 12:10 p.m. today (15), the Meteorology Department said.

title: 250 missing after migrant boat sinks in Indian Ocean
byline: About 250 Rohingya and Bangladeshis, including children, are missing after their boat capsized last week in the Andaman Sea, according to the United Nations’ refugee and migration agencies.

title: Rain expected after 1 p.m. in several provinces
byline: Showers or thundershowers are expected to occur at several places across the country after 1.00 p.m. today (15), the Meteorology Department said.

title: Trump hints Iran talks could resume this week as US port blockade continues
byline: President Donald Trump has suggested talks aimed at ending the war in Iran could resume this week, after negotiations collapsed at the weekend, prompting the US to blockade Iranian ports.

title: New Year return travel services start today
byline: Special transport services to facilitate the return of people who travelled to their hometowns for the Sinhala and Tamil New Year will commence from today (15).

title: Pope Leo issues warning on democracy after Trump criticism
byline: Pope Leo warned of the risk of democracies sliding into ’’majoritarian tyranny’’ on Tuesday, in a ​letter issued by the Vatican two days after U.S. ‌President Donald Trump attacked the pontiff on social media.

title: 240 Iranian naval crew members depart Sri Lanka
byline: Sri Lanka repatriated 240 Iranian naval personnel yesterday, following maritime incidents near the island.

title: Trump says Iran war is ’very close to being over’ as peace talks are expected to resume
byline: President Donald Trump said the U.S.-Iran war is ’’very close’’ to an end as hostilities ease amid a two-week ceasefire agreement.

title: Iran demands compensation from 5 Arab states over alleged participation in US-Israeli strikes
byline: Iran demanded compensation from five Arab countries, including Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, and Jordan, accusing them of participating in US-Israeli strikes on Iran.

title: UN watchdog says North Korea is boosting nuclear weapons capacity
byline: North Korea ​has made ’’very serious’’ advances in its abilities to turn out nuclear weapons, with the probable addition of a ‌new uranium enrichment facility, as it stepped up activity at a key complex, IAEA chief Rafael Grossi said on Wednesday.

title: Applications invited for Presidential Environment Awards – 2026
byline: The Central Environmental Authority (CEA) has commenced calling for applications for the “Presidential Environment Awards – 2026” programme.

title: Nadeesha Gayanthi bags gold and silver at England Badminton Championship
byline: Sri Lankan badminton player Nadeesha Gayanthi, who represented the country at the 108th All England Senior Badminton Championship held in England, returned home to a warm welcome after securing a gold and a silver medal at the international tournament.

title: US shuts down Iran’s maritime trade despite optimism for more talks
byline: The United States said on Wednesday its military had completely halted trade going in and out of Iran by sea, even though President ​Donald Trump said talks with Tehran on ending the war could resume this week.

title: 250 missing after migrant boat sinks in Indian Ocean
byline: About 250 Rohingya and Bangladeshis, including children, are missing after their boat capsized last week in the Andaman Sea, according to the United Nations’ refugee and migration agencies.

title: Trump hints Iran talks could resume this week as US port blockade continues
byline: President Donald Trump has suggested talks aimed at ending the war in Iran could resume this week, after negotiations collapsed at the weekend, prompting the US to blockade Iranian ports.

title: Over 200 Iranian naval crew members depart Sri Lanka
byline: Sri Lanka repatriated 240 Iranian naval personnel yesterday, following maritime incidents near the island.

title: Japan PM pledges $10 bil. in financial aid to Asia to tackle oil shortage
byline: The Japanese government said Wednesday it will provide a total of $10 billion in financial support to other Asian nations to help them secure crude oil supplies as prices soar amid the Middle East conflict, aiming to ensure that petroleum-derived products made in those countries keep flowing into Japan.

title: Chinese ship fails to break US blockade, turns back to Hormuz after brief win
byline: A US-sanctioned tanker linked to China changed course after sailing out of the Strait of Hormuz, where vessel movements are being closely watched following a naval blockade announced by Donald Trump. According to a Reuters report, the vessel. Rich Starry, made its way back to the Strait of Hormuz as it failed to break through the US blockade.
